comply-in.span: Processes text, images, and audio in a single unified architecture.
Connects meaning across different input types for richer understanding.
Combines visual and textual data to answer complex queries.
Adapts to new multimodal tasks without additional fine-tuning.

p: Multimodal AI is an artificial intelligence system that processes and integrates multiple types of data—such as text, images, and audio—within a single model, enabling it to understand, reason, and generate responses that leverage the combined context from different modalities, rather than relying on a single input type.

sec-head.p: The same multimodal pipeline animating in the diagram above, applied to your diverse data inputs.

card.p: The system accepts text, images, and audio simultaneously.
Each input type is converted into a shared embedding space.
The model aligns and merges representations from different modalities.
The combined context informs a unified understanding of the query.
The model generates a response that may include text, image, or audio.
